_doc: Every contract copy this repo pins from a producer, and the producer branch it must equal. scripts/harness/pinned_contract_gate.py fails when a copy differs from the producer's develop. Refresh = copy the file, never edit it. The five event pins cover every topic this repo's readers actually subscribe to (derived from the consumer topic constants in internal/adapters/inbound/kafka, not from spec operations); the inbound-receiving self-pin is this repo's own analytics topic, whose DLQ semantics the analytics contract tests cover.
